Judah Lewis is an American actor. Here's a summary of what I know about him:

- He was born on October 19, 2001 in Los Angeles, California. He is currently 21 years old.

- Some of his notable acting roles include:
- The Babysitter (2017) - He played the main character of Cole.
- The Christmas Chronicles (2018) - He played Teddy Pierce.
- The Christmas Chronicles 2 (2020) - He reprised his role as Teddy Pierce.

- He has appeared in a few other films and TV shows, but his roles in The Babysitter and The Christmas Chronicles movies are probably his most well-known work so far.

- Not much is publicly known about his personal life, as he tends to keep that private. He seems to be focused on his acting career at the moment.

- Reviews of his performances have been generally positive, with praise for his acting abilities at a young age.

That's the main information I was able to find about Judah Lewis based on my current knowledge. Let me know if you need any other details about his background or career.
